'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come on in. The airdrops keep coming in, and our job is to hold on to whatever we can intercept. If these assholes have mastered mortars, they'll be unstoppable with EWs and spare parts for them. Bring me everything you can get. I'll prepare a good reward.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 25 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Radar station spare parts]]
* Hand over 15 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare device]]s

==Rewards==
* +108,600 [[EXP]]
* 210,000 Roubles
** 220,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 241,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 5× [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Blue)]]
* 2× [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)]]
* 2× [[Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 bulletproof helmet (Black)]]
* 2× [[Vulkan-5 helmet face shield]]
* 1× [[Kalashnikov PKP 7.62x54R infantry machine gun]] (variant Zenit)
{{quote|I think we salvaged most of it, that's good. Now we wait.}}

[[Radar station spare parts]] can be found inside special airdrop crates that get dropped at the beginning of the second mortar fire barrage on [[Shoreline]], [[Woods]], [[Reserve]] and [[Customs]].

The [[GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare device|GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare devices]] have a chance to spawn on [[Rogues]] on [[Lighthouse]]. [[The Goons]] are guaranteed to have the devices on them.
